description: Pure engine layer: extract the shared OWASP CSV-escaper, then build the deterministic HighIncomeReviewPackage model + assembler + SHA-256 fingerprint (generatedAt EXCLUDED) + filing-mapping registry + JSON/CSV exporter in @atlas/tax-engine, consuming ONLY the 4I.4 AnnualHighIncomeAssessmentReadModel shape — with NO tax math and NO float. Includes the complete pure test surface (unit + >=10,000-case fuzz) and the architecture dependency-boundary assertions. Fully self-contained and verifiable without a database. This is the foundation FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 build on.

The assembler MUST: never call Date.now()/new Date(); copy every read-model field verbatim into the correct section; import HIGH_INCOME_MINIMUM_TAX_THRESHOLD_METRIC and HighIncomeMinimumTaxApplicabilityStatus from '@atlas/tax-engine' high-income module; derive Section2.applicable via a closed switch over the frozen applicability enum plus the fail-closed null-override (null when totalAnnualIncome or eligibilityThreshold is null) — NEVER by comparing the two decimal strings; derive package status via the top-down precedence table in design.md section 6 (UNSUPPORTED -> BLOCKED -> NOT_APPLICABLE -> READY_FOR_REVIEW -> else INCOMPLETE); Section 3 performs NO cross-row/cross-category sum and exposes no income total other than verbatim totalAnnualIncome (surfaced in Section 2); Section 6 two-branch present/absent rule (corporateRedutor===null -> present:false with null/empty defaults; else copy verbatim preserving null-vs-value, never turning a null total into '0'); Section 7 derives counts with partition total === ready+missing+stale+conflicting+unsupported (precedence conflicting>stale>unsupported>missing>ready) and emits Section7EvidenceRow with rowKey = `${evidenceType}:${payerId ?? '_ANNUAL_'}:${revision}` and NO id / NO supersedesId (DB UUIDs used only as in-memory sort tiebreakers); sort all arrays canonically before hashing (payers by payerId ASC, breakdown by category+classification, evidence by (evidenceType, payerKey, revision)); echo generatedAt only in Section1/top-level, never in the fingerprint input.

FOR FEAT-002/FEAT-003:
- The assembler input type is HighIncomeReviewAssessmentInput, declared locally in the engine (NOT imported from apps/api) but STRUCTURALLY IDENTICAL to apps/api AnnualHighIncomeAssessmentReadModel. The API use-case passes the read model straight in (assignable).
- generatedAt is injected via options.generatedAt (ISO string). Engine NEVER calls Date.now()/new Date(). The API application layer must supply the clock (use FISCAL_CLOCK token's today() or equivalent ISO).
- Fingerprint input shape = HighIncomeReviewFingerprintInput: { packageVersion, ruleVersion, calendarYear, declarationExercise, status, sourceFingerprint, calculationFingerprint, upstreamIncomeFingerprint, upstreamCapitalMarketFingerprint, section2..section7, section9 }. EXCLUDES generatedAt and section1Identity and section8Provenance. SHA-256 over stableStringify (lexicographic key sort; arrays kept in assembler-sorted order).
- Section7EvidenceRow fields: { rowKey, evidenceType, payerId (string|null), authority, evidenceSource, conflictStatus, stale, revision, sourceFingerprint, fingerprint }. NO id, NO supersedesId. rowKey = `${evidenceType}:${payerId ?? '_ANNUAL_'}:${revision}`. DB UUIDs (evidence.id/supersedesId) are used ONLY as in-memory sort tiebreakers and never serialized.
- Disclaimer/banner constants: HIGH_INCOME_REVIEW_BANNER (the compulsory banner) and HIGH_INCOME_REVIEW_DISCLAIMER (banner + full text). CSV header prefixes '# ' before each. pkg.disclaimer === HIGH_INCOME_REVIEW_DISCLAIMER.
- Package status precedence (top-down): UNSUPPORTED (applicability==='UNSUPPORTED_YEAR') -> BLOCKED (status/applicability/upstreamIncomeStatus==='BLOCKED' OR blockingReasons.length>0) -> NOT_APPLICABLE (applicability==='NOT_APPLICABLE') -> READY_FOR_REVIEW (applicability==='APPLICABLE' AND netMinimumTax!==null) -> else INCOMPLETE. netMinimumTax surfaced in Section4 only when status===READY_FOR_REVIEW; netIsAuthoritative mirrors that.
- Export route stem for FEAT-002: atlas-alta-renda-<year>-relatorio-apoio.<ext>; add Cache-Control private,no-store + Pragma no-cache (new vs 4H).
- Architecture test for the API use-case import assertion (consume 4I.4 use-case, not raw calculate*) is deferred to FEAT-002 per step 8 note.
